whoItsFor: Developers and creators who use a coding agent such as Claude Code and want to make short films without a video model. Anyone who wants to pick one of the 43 film styles and direct an animated short from their own story.
useCases: Direct a short film in a chosen art style from your own story
Preview the key shots as a storyboard before rendering the full film
Make explainer-style videos in styles such as whiteboard or infographic
